posts.title: F3 Lightning: How Meta Accelerates Ads ML Features to Production at Scale
posts.summary: Engineers built a DAG-based feature compiler that merges shared feature computations to serve thousands of ad features efficiently.

posts.title: Catching Bugs Before They Land: JiTTesting’s Human-on-the-Loop Approach at Full Scale
posts.summary: Used LLMs to auto‑generate and judge tests that catch bugs before code lands, improving reliability while maintaining engineer velocity.

posts.title: Meta Andromeda: Powering the Next Generation of Ads Retrieval Through Model-System Co-Design
posts.summary: Engineers co‑designed model, system, and hardware to run a GPU‑optimized deep network that retrieves billions of personalized ads per second while keeping compute costs low.

posts.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
posts.summary: Introduced a sleep phase that lets deployed LLMs periodically update themselves with new facts, preventing forgetting and improving reasoning.

posts.title: Making Failure Diagnosis Reliable with Pensive AI
posts.summary: Implemented an AI layer to automatically extract and classify failure logs, improving coverage and reducing manual debugging effort.

posts.title: Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening
posts.summary: Developed and fine‑tuned foundation vision models to interpret chest X‑rays for TB screening, enabling point‑of‑care diagnosis in low‑resource settings.

posts.title: Empowering frontline maternal care with AI-assisted ultrasound
posts.summary: Developed a mobile AI model that interprets blind‑sweep ultrasounds to give expert‑level gestational age estimates, enabling low‑resource frontline care.

posts.title: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
posts.summary: Implemented a thin orchestrator that routes tasks to specialized AI agents, improving reliability by reducing each agent's domain scope.

posts.title: GenRecs Tokenization: Transforming Ads Recommendation at Meta with Stable Model Vocabulary
posts.summary: Implemented a semantic tokenization pipeline that encodes ads into embeddings, enabling LLM-based retrieval and ranking of new items without prior engagement data.

posts.title: Inside Prometheus: Meta’s Journey to a Gigawatt-Scale Supercluster
Grounding AI agents in biological reality: Building blocks for autonomous wet labs
posts.summary: Developed AI agents that control lab robots, generate and execute experiments, and learn from results to accelerate protein binder discovery.

posts.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
posts.summary: Developed a geospatial reasoning agent that orchestrates foundation models and data sources to perform multi-step spatial analysis and predictions.

posts.title: Integrating Netflix’s Foundation Model into Personalization applications
posts.summary: Integrated a large transformer foundation model into Netflix personalization by generating daily user and item embeddings and fine‑tuning for low‑latency recommendations.

posts.title: Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health
posts.summary: Created location embeddings from satellite and mobility data to improve epidemiological models for disease monitoring and resource allocation.

posts.title: How Diffusion Controller unifies and simplifies AI image generation
posts.summary: Engineers added a lightweight control network to diffusion models to better align generated images with prompts while preserving quality.

posts.title: Bypassing inference bottlenecks: Accelerating complex AI search with Retrieve-for-Train
posts.summary: Trained a lightweight diffusion retriever via offline RL to generate diverse, coherent result sets in a single pass, avoiding heavy inference.

posts.title: Transfer learning for genomic prediction in underrepresented populations
posts.summary: Evaluated transfer learning for polygenic risk scores, showing how model training and dataset size affect prediction accuracy in underrepresented populations.

posts.title: Mapping global methane emissions from space with deep learning
posts.summary: Developed a deep‑learning pipeline that labels satellite hyperspectral images, detects methane plumes, and estimates their sources to enable global monitoring.

posts.title: TimesFM-3: A zero-shot foundation model for multivariate forecasting
posts.summary: Developed a 330M-parameter decoder-only transformer that zero-shot forecasts multivariate time series by jointly modeling multiple related signals.

posts.title: Planetary prediction engine: Automating global models via Earth AI
posts.summary: Automated system discovers geospatial data, engineers features, trains and evaluates models to predict health, food security, and environmental risks.

posts.title: GlucoFM: Foundation model for continuous glucose monitoring
posts.summary: Developed a dual‑stream self‑supervised foundation model for glucose data, improving prediction of diabetes risk and related health outcomes.

posts.title: How mobility gives language models a deeper understanding of place
posts.summary: Created mobility‑enhanced place embeddings by blending text with aggregated movement data, improving predictions of opening hours, price levels, and busyness.

posts.title: An AI tool for prioritizing candidate biomarkers from wearable sensor data
posts.summary: Built a multi‑agent system that generates hypotheses, runs statistical analyses, and validates wearable sensor biomarkers to improve predictive health models.

posts.title: Introducing TabFM: A zero-shot foundation model for tabular data
posts.summary: The team built TabFM, a zero-shot foundation model that predicts tabular classification and regression tasks without training per dataset, and deployed it via BigQuery.

posts.title: Accelerating Gemini Nano models on Pixel with frozen Multi-Token Prediction
posts.summary: Implemented Multi-Token Prediction on frozen Gemini Nano models to speed up on-device text generation while reducing energy use.

posts.title: From pixels to planning: Earth AI for nature restoration
posts.summary: Developed a high‑resolution deep learning model to detect fine‑scale ecological features from satellite imagery and output actionable vector maps for restoration planning.

posts.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform’s Agentic RAG
posts.summary: Built a multi‑agent RAG system that iteratively searches and reasons across data sources to provide more accurate enterprise answers.

posts.title: It's all about the angle: Your photos, re-composed
posts.summary: Implemented a ML pipeline that infers 3D scene geometry from a photo and uses generative inpainting to create new viewpoints, now live in Google Photos.

posts.title: ReasoningBank: Enabling agents to learn from experience
posts.summary: Developed a memory framework that lets agents retrieve and distill past successes and failures to improve reasoning and task efficiency.

posts.title: AI-generated synthetic neurons speed up brain mapping
posts.summary: Created synthetic neuron shapes to augment training data, reducing reconstruction errors and speeding up brain mapping.

posts.title: Towards developing future-ready skills with generative AI
posts.summary: Created a generative AI sandbox that simulates conversations to assess future-ready skills for students, enabling scalable, automated evaluation.

posts.title: Improving the academic workflow: Introducing two AI agents for better figures and peer review
posts.summary: Built two AI agents that generate academic figures and automatically review papers, reducing manual effort and improving review consistency.

posts.title: Evaluating alignment of behavioral dispositions in LLMs
posts.summary: Created a framework to assess how closely LLMs' behavioral tendencies match human social norms using situational judgment tests.

posts.title: Vibe Coding XR: Accelerating AI + XR prototyping with XR Blocks and Gemini
posts.summary: The team built a workflow where Gemini LLM interprets natural language prompts to generate physics‑aware WebXR code, enabling rapid XR prototyping.

posts.title: TurboQuant: Redefining AI efficiency with extreme compression
posts.summary: Developed quantization algorithms to compress high‑dimensional vectors, reducing memory use and speeding up similarity lookups in vector search systems.

posts.title: Improving breast cancer screening workflows with machine learning
posts.summary: Developed and evaluated an AI mammography system to improve cancer detection accuracy and reduce radiologist workload in NHS screening.

posts.title: Protecting cities with AI-driven flash flood forecasting
posts.summary: Developed and deployed AI models that forecast urban flash floods up to 24 hours ahead to improve early warning systems.

posts.title: Exploring the feasibility of conversational diagnostic AI in a real-world clinical study
posts.summary: Deployed a conversational medical AI to collect patient histories in clinics and evaluated its safety and feasibility.
